# Open Primitive Protocol — Complete Documentation

> The data layer of the agent internet. 30 US federal data domains, infrastructure services, signed responses, cross-domain intelligence. Every response carries provenance, confidence, and citation metadata.

Base URL: https://api.openprimitive.com


## The Open Primitive Protocol (OPP)

Open Primitive is the reference implementation of OPP — an open standard for serving government data to AI agents with built-in provenance, confidence scoring, and cryptographic proof.

Any data provider can implement OPP. The spec lives at https://openprimitive.com/protocol.html.

### Protocol Manifest

Every OPP-compliant server publishes a manifest at `/.well-known/opp.json`. The manifest declares:
- Supported domains
- Available endpoints
- Response signing method
- Data freshness guarantees

### Response Envelope

Every OPP response carries a standard envelope:

```json
{
  "domain": "water",
  "source": "EPA SDWIS",
  "source_url": "https://enviro.epa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "citations": [
    { "title": "EPA SDWIS Federal Reports", "url": "https://enviro.epa.gov/..." }
  ],
  "proof": {
    "algorithm": "Ed25519",
    "publicKey": "...",
    "signature": "..."
  }
}
```

Fields:
- **domain** — which data domain produced the result
- **source** — the federal agency or data program name
- **source_url** — URL of the upstream data source
- **freshness** — ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was fetched
- **confidence** — 0.0 to 1.0 score reflecting data completeness and recency
- **citations** — array of source references with title and URL
- **proof** — Ed25519 signature over the response body, verifiable against the public key in the manifest


## Authentication

No API key required. Completely free, no limits. Just call the endpoints.


---


## Domain: Flights

Live FAA ground delays and hub airport weather for 8 major US carriers.

Source: FAA National Airspace System Status + Open-Meteo
Source URL: https://nasstatus.faa.gov

Airlines covered: Delta (DL), United (UA), American (AA), Southwest (WN), Alaska (AS), JetBlue (B6), Allegiant (G4), Frontier (F9)

### GET /v1/flights

Returns all 8 airlines with current delay status and 4-day weather forecast at each primary hub.

No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/flights
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "flights",
  "source": "FAA NAS + Open-Meteo",
  "source_url": "https://nasstatus.faa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "airlines": [
    {
      "name": "Delta",
      "iata": "DL",
      "hubs": ["ATL", "MSP", "DTW", "SLC"],
      "delays": [
        { "airport": "ATL", "reason": "TM Initiatives:MIT:VOL", "delay": "16 minutes" }
      ],
      "hasDelays": true,
      "weather": [
        { "day": 1, "weatherCode": 3, "precipitation": 0.2 },
        { "day": 2, "weatherCode": 61, "precipitation": 5.1 }
      ],
      "primaryHub": "ATL"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/flights/:iata

Returns a single airline by IATA code.

Parameters:
- iata (path, required) — two-letter IATA airline code: DL, UA, AA, WN, AS, B6, G4, F9

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/flights/DL
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "flights",
  "source": "FAA NAS + Open-Meteo",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "name": "Delta",
  "iata": "DL",
  "hubs": ["ATL", "MSP", "DTW", "SLC"],
  "delays": [],
  "hasDelays": false,
  "weather": [
    { "day": 1, "weatherCode": 0, "precipitation": 0 }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: delays come from FAA NAS real-time status. If an airport has an active ground delay program, ground stop, or traffic management initiative, it appears in the delays array. Weather codes follow WMO standard (0 = clear, 61 = rain, 71 = snow). Precipitation is in millimeters.


---


## Domain: Cars

NHTSA crash safety ratings and active recall notices for vehicles sold in the US.

Source: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
Source URL: https://api.nhtsa.gov

### GET /v1/cars

Parameters:
- year (query, required) — model year, e.g. "2024"
- make (query, required) — manufacturer, e.g. "Toyota"
- model (query, required) — model name, e.g. "Camry"

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/cars?year=2024&make=Toyota&model=Camry"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "cars",
  "source": "NHTSA",
  "source_url": "https://api.nhtsa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "year": "2024",
  "make": "Toyota",
  "model": "Camry",
  "ratings": {
    "OverallRating": "5",
    "OverallFrontCrashRating": "4",
    "FrontCrashDriversideRating": "4",
    "FrontCrashPassengersideRating": "5",
    "OverallSideCrashRating": "5",
    "RolloverRating": "4"
  },
  "variants": [
    { "vehicleId": 12345, "description": "2024 Toyota Camry 4 DR FWD" }
  ],
  "recalls": [
    {
      "component": "FUEL SYSTEM",
      "summary": "Fuel pump may fail...",
      "consequence": "Engine stall while driving...",
      "remedy": "Dealers will replace the fuel pump..."
    }
  ],
  "recallCount": 1
}
```

What the data means: ratings are 1-5 stars (5 = best). Recalls are open campaigns — if your vehicle matches, take it to a dealer. Returns null for ratings if NHTSA has not tested that vehicle.


---


## Domain: Food

Active FDA food recall enforcement actions.

Source: FDA Enforcement Reports
Source URL: https://api.fda.gov

### GET /v1/food

Returns the 20 most recent active food recalls from the last 90 days. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/food
```

### GET /v1/food?q=

Search food recalls by product name or brand.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — search term, e.g. "peanut butter" or "Trader Joe"

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/food?q=salmonella"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "food",
  "source": "FDA Enforcement",
  "source_url": "https://api.fda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "total": 47,
  "recalls": [
    {
      "product": "Organic Peanut Butter, 16 oz jar",
      "firm": "Example Foods Inc",
      "classification": "Class I",
      "status": "Ongoing",
      "reason": "Salmonella contamination",
      "distribution": "Nationwide",
      "date": "20260301",
      "quantity": "5,000 cases",
      "recallNumber": "F-0123-2026"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: classification indicates severity. Class I = serious health risk or death. Class II = temporary or reversible health consequences. Class III = unlikely to cause adverse health effects.


---


## Domain: Water

EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System — water systems and violations by location.

Source: EPA SDWIS
Source URL: https://enviro.epa.gov

### GET /v1/water?zip=

Find water systems serving a ZIP code.

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/water?zip=48201"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "water",
  "source": "EPA SDWIS",
  "source_url": "https://enviro.epa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip": "48201",
  "systems": [
    {
      "pwsid": "MI0000101",
      "name": "DETROIT WATER AND SEWERAGE DEPT",
      "populationServed": 670000,
      "type": "CWS",
      "primarySource": "SW",
      "city": "DETROIT",
      "state": "MI"
    }
  ],
  "count": 3
}
```

### GET /v1/water/:pwsid

Get detailed violations for a specific water system.

Parameters:
- pwsid (path, required) — Public Water System ID (9-12 alphanumeric characters, e.g. "MI0000101")

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/water/MI0000101
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "water",
  "source": "EPA SDWIS",
  "source_url": "https://enviro.epa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "pwsid": "MI0000101",
  "system": {
    "pwsid": "MI0000101",
    "name": "DETROIT WATER AND SEWERAGE DEPT",
    "populationServed": 670000,
    "type": "CWS",
    "primarySource": "SW",
    "city": "DETROIT",
    "state": "MI"
  },
  "violations": {
    "healthBased": [
      {
        "contaminant": "LEAD",
        "type": "Maximum Contaminant Level Violation",
        "category": "MCL",
        "beginDate": "2025-01-01",
        "endDate": "2025-06-30",
        "status": "open",
        "healthBased": true
      }
    ],
    "monitoring": [],
    "total": 1
  }
}
```

What the data means: healthBased violations (MCL, MRDL, TT) mean a contaminant exceeded the legal limit or a treatment technique failed. Monitoring violations mean the system failed to test on schedule. Type codes — CWS = community water system, SW = surface water, GW = groundwater.


---


## Domain: Drugs

FDA adverse event reports and drug label warnings.

Source: FDA FAERS (Adverse Event Reporting System) + FDA Drug Labels
Source URL: https://api.fda.gov

### GET /v1/drugs?name=

Parameters:
- name (query, required) — drug name, brand or generic (e.g. "ibuprofen", "Ozempic", "metformin")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/drugs?name=ibuprofen"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "drugs",
  "source": "FDA FAERS + Drug Labels",
  "source_url": "https://api.fda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "drug": "ibuprofen",
  "totalEvents": 185432,
  "seriousEvents": 98201,
  "deathEvents": 4532,
  "recentEvents": 12300,
  "topReactions": [
    { "reaction": "DRUG INEFFECTIVE", "count": 8921 },
    { "reaction": "NAUSEA", "count": 7654 },
    { "reaction": "DIZZINESS", "count": 5432 }
  ],
  "labelWarnings": {
    "warnings": "Cardiovascular Risk: NSAIDs may cause an increased risk...",
    "adverseReactions": "The most common adverse reactions (>1%) are..."
  }
}
```

What the data means: totalEvents is the count of adverse event reports filed with the FDA. These are voluntary reports — a high count does not prove causation. It reflects how widely a drug is used and how actively it is reported. seriousEvents required hospitalization, disability, or were life-threatening. deathEvents had a death outcome. topReactions are the most frequently reported symptoms. labelWarnings come from the FDA-approved drug label.


---


## Domain: Drug Labels

Full FDA-approved drug labeling from DailyMed (National Library of Medicine).

Source: DailyMed (NLM)
Source URL: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov

### GET /v1/drug-labels?name=

Parameters:
- name (query, required) — drug name, brand or generic (e.g. "aspirin", "Lipitor")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/drug-labels?name=aspirin"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "drug-labels",
  "source": "DailyMed (NLM)",
  "source_url": "https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "drug": "aspirin",
  "labels": [
    {
      "setId": "abc123-def456",
      "title": "ASPIRIN tablet",
      "labeler": "Example Pharma Inc"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: DailyMed is the official source for FDA-approved drug labels. Each label includes the full prescribing information, warnings, indications, and dosage. The setId is a unique identifier for retrieving the complete structured label.


---


## Domain: Drug Interactions

FDA label-derived drug interaction checking between two medications.

Source: FDA Drug Labels (openFDA)
Source URL: https://api.fda.gov

### GET /v1/drug-interactions?drug1=&drug2=

Parameters:
- drug1 (query, required) — first drug name (brand or generic)
- drug2 (query, required) — second drug name (brand or generic)

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/drug-interactions?drug1=warfarin&drug2=aspirin"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "drug-interactions",
  "source": "FDA Drug Labels",
  "source_url": "https://api.fda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "drug1": "warfarin",
  "drug2": "aspirin",
  "interactionFound": true,
  "severity": "major",
  "details": "Concurrent use may increase the risk of bleeding..."
}
```

What the data means: interaction data is extracted from FDA-approved drug labels. The check looks for mentions of drug2 in drug1's interaction and warning sections, and vice versa. Severity levels are "major", "moderate", "minor", or "none". This is not a substitute for clinical pharmacist review.


---


## Domain: Hospitals

CMS hospital quality ratings, mortality, readmissions, and patient experience.

Source: CMS Care Compare (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services)
Source URL: https://data.cms.gov

### GET /v1/hospitals?q=

Search hospitals by name or ZIP code.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — hospital name or 5-digit ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/hospitals?q=Mayo"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "hospitals",
  "source": "CMS Care Compare",
  "source_url": "https://data.cms.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "Mayo",
  "results": [
    {
      "providerId": "240010",
      "name": "MAYO CLINIC HOSPITAL SAINT MARYS",
      "city": "ROCHESTER",
      "state": "MN",
      "zip": "55905",
      "overallRating": "5",
      "type": "Acute Care Hospitals",
      "phone": "5072845005"
    }
  ],
  "count": 3
}
```

### GET /v1/hospitals?id=

Get detailed quality data for a single hospital.

Parameters:
- id (query, required) — CMS Provider ID (e.g. "240010")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/hospitals?id=240010"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "hospitals",
  "source": "CMS Care Compare",
  "source_url": "https://data.cms.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "providerId": "240010",
  "name": "MAYO CLINIC HOSPITAL SAINT MARYS",
  "city": "ROCHESTER",
  "state": "MN",
  "zip": "55905",
  "phone": "5072845005",
  "type": "Acute Care Hospitals",
  "overallRating": "5",
  "mortality": [
    { "measure": "Death rate for heart attack", "score": "11.2", "comparison": "same" }
  ],
  "readmissions": [
    { "measure": "Rate of readmission for heart attack", "score": "15.8", "comparison": "better" }
  ],
  "patientExperience": [
    { "measure": "Overall hospital rating", "score": "4", "comparison": null }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: overallRating is 1-5 stars (5 = best). Comparison values are "better", "worse", or "same" relative to the national average. Mortality and readmission scores are percentages.


---


## Domain: Health

PubMed research evidence for health claims and supplements.

Source: PubMed/MEDLINE (National Library of Medicine)
Source URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov

### GET /v1/health?q=

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — supplement name or health claim (e.g. "vitamin d immune", "turmeric inflammation", "melatonin sleep")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/health?q=turmeric+inflammation"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "health",
  "source": "PubMed/MEDLINE",
  "source_url": "https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "turmeric inflammation",
  "totalStudies": 1842,
  "evidence": "Strong research signal",
  "evidenceLevel": "strong",
  "odsUrl": "https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/Turmeric-HealthProfessional/",
  "studies": [
    {
      "id": "39012345",
      "title": "Curcumin and inflammatory markers: a systematic review",
      "journal": "Journal of Clinical Medicine",
      "pubDate": "2026 Mar",
      "authors": "Smith J et al.",
      "url": "https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39012345/"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: evidenceLevel tiers — "strong" (500+ studies), "moderate" (50-499), "limited" (10-49), "weak" (1-9), "none" (0). odsUrl links to the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements fact sheet when available. The 5 most recent studies are returned with PubMed links.


---


## Domain: Clinical Trials

Active clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition or intervention.

Source: ClinicalTrials.gov (NLM)
Source URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov

### GET /v1/clinical-trials?q=

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — condition or intervention (e.g. "lung cancer", "mRNA vaccine", "diabetes")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/clinical-trials?q=lung+cancer"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "clinical-trials",
  "source": "ClinicalTrials.gov",
  "source_url": "https://clinicaltrials.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "lung cancer",
  "total": 8432,
  "studies": [
    {
      "nctId": "NCT06012345",
      "title": "Phase III Trial of Novel Immunotherapy in NSCLC",
      "status": "RECRUITING",
      "phase": "PHASE3",
      "conditions": ["Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer"],
      "interventions": ["Drug: Pembrolizumab"],
      "startDate": "2025-09-01",
      "sponsor": "National Cancer Institute"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: returns the 10 most relevant active trials. Status values include RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION. Phase values follow the ClinicalTrials.gov taxonomy. The nctId is the unique trial identifier.

## Domain: Nutrition

USDA nutrition data for any food.

Source: USDA FoodData Central
Source URL: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov

### GET /v1/nutrition?q=

Search foods by name.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — food search term (e.g. "banana", "cheddar cheese", "chicken breast")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/nutrition?q=banana"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "nutrition",
  "source": "USDA FoodData Central",
  "source_url": "https://fdc.nal.usda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "banana",
  "total": 1523,
  "results": [
    {
      "fdcId": 173944,
      "description": "Bananas, raw",
      "brandName": null,
      "dataType": "SR Legacy",
      "nutrients": [
        { "name": "Calories", "amount": 89, "unit": "kcal" },
        { "name": "Protein", "amount": 1.09, "unit": "g" },
        { "name": "Total Fat", "amount": 0.33, "unit": "g" },
        { "name": "Carbohydrates", "amount": 22.84, "unit": "g" },
        { "name": "Fiber", "amount": 2.6, "unit": "g" },
        { "name": "Sugar", "amount": 12.23, "unit": "g" },
        { "name": "Sodium", "amount": 1, "unit": "mg" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/nutrition?id=

Get full nutrient profile for a specific food.

Parameters:
- id (query, required) — FDC ID from a search result (e.g. "173944")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/nutrition?id=173944"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "nutrition",
  "source": "USDA FoodData Central",
  "source_url": "https://fdc.nal.usda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "fdcId": 173944,
  "description": "Bananas, raw",
  "brandName": null,
  "dataType": "SR Legacy",
  "servingSize": 118,
  "servingSizeUnit": "g",
  "nutrients": [
    { "name": "Energy", "amount": 89, "unit": "KCAL" },
    { "name": "Protein", "amount": 1.09, "unit": "G" },
    { "name": "Vitamin C, total ascorbic acid", "amount": 8.7, "unit": "MG" }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: search results include 7 key nutrients (calories, protein, fat, carbs, fiber, sugar, sodium). The detail endpoint returns the complete nutrient profile including all vitamins and minerals. Nutrient values are per 100g unless servingSize is specified.

## Domain: Meat

USDA FSIS meat, poultry, and egg product recall notices and federally inspected establishment data.

Source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS)
Source URL: https://www.fsis.usda.gov

### GET /v1/meat

Returns recent meat and poultry recalls. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/meat
```

### GET /v1/meat?q=

Search meat recalls by keyword.

Parameters:
- q (query, optional) — product type or keyword (e.g. "chicken", "salmonella", "E. coli")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/meat?q=chicken"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "meat",
  "source": "USDA FSIS",
  "source_url": "https://www.fsis.usda.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "total": 12,
  "recalls": [
    {
      "recallNumber": "012-2026",
      "product": "Frozen Chicken Nuggets",
      "reason": "Possible Salmonella contamination",
      "classification": "Class I",
      "pounds": "45,000",
      "date": "2026-03-15"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: FSIS recalls cover meat, poultry, and processed egg products — these are separate from FDA food recalls. Classification follows the same I/II/III severity scale. Pounds indicates the volume of product recalled.


---


## Domain: Jobs

Bureau of Labor Statistics economic data — unemployment, CPI, employment, wages.

Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics
Source URL: https://www.bls.gov

### GET /v1/jobs

Returns the current unemployment rate (seasonally adjusted). No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/jobs
```

### GET /v1/jobs?series=

Get any BLS time series by ID.

Parameters:
- series (query, required) — BLS series ID

Common series IDs:
- LNS14000000 — Unemployment rate (seasonally adjusted)
- CUUR0000SA0 — Consumer Price Index, all urban consumers
- CES0000000001 — Total nonfarm payrolls

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/jobs?series=CUUR0000SA0"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "jobs",
  "source": "Bureau of Labor Statistics",
  "source_url": "https://www.bls.gov/",
  "freshness": "2026-02",
  "series": "LNS14000000",
  "latest": { "year": "2026", "month": "02", "value": "3.9" },
  "history": [
    { "year": "2026", "month": "02", "value": "3.9" },
    { "year": "2026", "month": "01", "value": "4.0" },
    { "year": "2025", "month": "12", "value": "4.1" }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: returns the last 2 years of monthly data points, newest first. Values are strings (BLS convention). For unemployment, the value is a percentage of the labor force. For CPI, it is an index level.


---


## Domain: Demographics

US Census American Community Survey data by ZIP code.

Source: US Census Bureau, ACS 5-Year Estimates (2023)
Source URL: https://api.census.gov

### GET /v1/demographics?zip=

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/demographics?zip=90210"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "demographics",
  "source": "US Census ACS 5-Year",
  "source_url": "https://api.census.gov",
  "freshness": "2023 5-year estimates",
  "zip": "90210",
  "population": 21741,
  "medianIncome": 153146,
  "povertyRate": 7.2,
  "collegeRate": 41.3,
  "medianHomeValue": 2875000,
  "medianRent": 2847
}
```

What the data means: population is total residents. medianIncome is annual household income in dollars. povertyRate is the percentage below the federal poverty line. collegeRate is the percentage with a bachelor's degree or higher. medianHomeValue and medianRent are in dollars.


---


## Domain: Products

Consumer Product Safety Commission recall notices.

Source: CPSC SaferProducts.gov
Source URL: https://www.saferproducts.gov

### GET /v1/products

Returns recent product recalls from the last 90 days. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/products
```

### GET /v1/products?q=

Search product recalls by keyword.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — product type or brand (e.g. "crib", "Samsung", "space heater")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/products?q=space+heater"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "products",
  "source": "CPSC",
  "source_url": "https://www.saferproducts.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "total": 5,
  "recalls": [
    {
      "recallId": "26-123",
      "title": "Space Heaters Recalled Due to Fire Hazard",
      "description": "The heater can overheat and ignite nearby materials...",
      "products": [{ "name": "Portable Space Heater", "type": "Heating" }],
      "hazards": ["Fire", "Burn"],
      "remedies": ["Refund"],
      "manufacturers": ["Example Corp"],
      "recallDate": "2026-02-15",
      "url": "https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: CPSC recalls cover household goods, children's products, electronics, and outdoor equipment. Hazards describe the risk. Remedies describe what the manufacturer offers (refund, repair, replacement).

SEC EDGAR corporate filings and financial facts.

Source: SEC EDGAR (Securities and Exchange Commission)
Source URL: https://www.sec.gov


```json
  "companies": [
    {
      "name": "APPLE INC",
      "cik": "320193",
      "ticker": "AAPL",
      "filings": [
        { "form": "10-K", "date": "2025-11-01", "url": "https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?..." }
      ]
```

### GET /v1/sec?cik=

Get structured financial facts for a company by CIK number.


Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "sec",
  "source": "SEC EDGAR",
  "source_url": "https://www.sec.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "cik": "320193",
  "name": "Apple Inc.",
  "facts": {
    "revenue": [
      { "year": 2025, "value": 394328000000 },
      { "year": 2024, "value": 383285000000 }
    ],

    ],
    "totalAssets": [
      { "year": 2025, "value": 352583000000 }
    ],
    "totalLiabilities": [
      { "year": 2025, "value": 290437000000 }
    ],
    "eps": [
      { "year": 2025, "value": 6.42 }
    ]
  }
}
```

What the data means: facts are extracted from 10-K annual filings using US GAAP taxonomy. Revenue, netIncome, totalAssets, and totalLiabilities are in USD. EPS is in USD per share. Years are sorted newest first.

## Domain: Weather

NOAA National Weather Service 7-day forecast by coordinates.

Source: NOAA National Weather Service
Source URL: https://api.weather.gov

### GET /v1/weather?lat=&lng=

Parameters:
- lat (query, required) — latitude (e.g. "40.7128")
- lng (query, required) — longitude (e.g. "-74.0060")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/weather?lat=40.7128&lng=-74.0060"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "weather",
  "source": "NOAA National Weather Service",
  "source_url": "https://api.weather.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "forecast": [
    {
      "name": "Tonight",
      "temperature": 42,
      "temperatureUnit": "F",
      "windSpeed": "8 mph",
      "windDirection": "NW",
      "shortForecast": "Partly Cloudy",
      "detailedForecast": "Partly cloudy, with a low around 42..."
    },
    {
      "name": "Thursday",
      "temperature": 58,
      "temperatureUnit": "F",
      "windSpeed": "12 mph",
      "windDirection": "S",
      "shortForecast": "Sunny",
      "detailedForecast": "Sunny, with a high near 58..."
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: returns up to 14 periods (7 days, day and night). Temperature is in Fahrenheit. Wind speed includes units. The NWS API covers US locations only.

## Domain: Air Quality

Real-time air quality index (AQI) by ZIP code from EPA AirNow.

Source: EPA AirNow
Source URL: https://www.airnow.gov

### GET /v1/air?zip=

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/air?zip=90210"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "air",
  "source": "EPA AirNow",
  "source_url": "https://www.airnow.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip": "90210",
  "aqi": 42,
  "category": "Good",
  "dominantPollutant": "PM2.5",
  "observations": [
    {
      "parameter": "PM2.5",
      "aqi": 42,
      "category": "Good"
    },
    {
      "parameter": "O3",
      "aqi": 35,
      "category": "Good"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: AQI ranges from 0-500. 0-50 = Good, 51-100 = Moderate, 101-150 = Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups, 151-200 = Unhealthy, 201-300 = Very Unhealthy, 301-500 = Hazardous. The dominant pollutant is the one driving the highest AQI reading.

## Domain: Earthquakes

Recent earthquake activity from the USGS Earthquake Hazards Program.

Source: USGS
Source URL: https://earthquake.usgs.gov

### GET /v1/earthquakes

Returns earthquakes of magnitude 2.5+ from the last 24 hours. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/earthquakes
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "earthquakes",
  "source": "USGS",
  "source_url": "https://earthquake.usgs.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "total": 15,
  "earthquakes": [
    {
      "magnitude": 4.2,
      "place": "18 km SE of Ridgecrest, CA",
      "time": "2026-04-12T10:23:00.000Z",
      "depth": 8.5,
      "tsunami": false,
      "url": "https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: magnitude is on the Richter scale. Depth is in kilometers below the surface. The tsunami field indicates whether a tsunami warning was issued. Returns up to 20 events sorted by time (newest first).

## Domain: Eligible

Federal benefits eligibility screening based on household income, size, and state.

Source: HHS Poverty Guidelines + CMS + IRS + HUD
Source URL: https://aspe.hhs.gov

### GET /v1/eligible

Parameters:
- income (query, required) — annual household income in dollars
- householdSize (query, required) — number of people in household
- state (query, optional) — two-letter state code (e.g. "CA", "TX")
- zip (query, optional) — 5-digit ZIP code
- children (query, optional) — number of children
- age (query, optional) — age of primary applicant

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/eligible?income=25000&householdSize=3&state=CA"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "eligible",
  "source": "HHS + CMS + IRS + HUD",
  "source_url": "https://aspe.hhs.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "income": 25000,
  "householdSize": 3,
  "fpl": 24390,
  "fplPercentage": 102,
  "programs": [
    {
      "name": "Medicaid",
      "eligible": true,
      "reason": "Income below 138% FPL in Medicaid expansion state"
    },
    {
      "name": "SNAP",
      "eligible": true,
      "reason": "Income below 130% FPL"
    },
    {
      "name": "EITC",
      "eligible": true,
      "maxCredit": 6960
    },
    {
      "name": "CHIP",
      "eligible": true,
      "reason": "Children eligible up to 266% FPL in CA"
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: uses 2026 Federal Poverty Level guidelines to screen against Medicaid, SNAP, CHIP, EITC, WIC, Section 8, Lifeline, LIHEAP, and other federal programs. Results are indicative — actual eligibility depends on additional factors determined by state agencies.

## Domain: Courts

Federal court opinions and docket records from CourtListener (Free Law Project).

Source: CourtListener (Free Law Project)
Source URL: https://www.courtlistener.com

### GET /v1/courts?q=

Search federal court opinions by keyword.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — search term (e.g. "qualified immunity", "Section 230")
- court (query, optional) — court identifier (e.g. "scotus", "ca9")
- dateAfter (query, optional) — filter by filing date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- dateBefore (query, optional) — filter by filing date (YYYY-MM-DD)

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/courts?q=qualified+immunity"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "courts",

  "source_url": "https://www.courtlistener.com",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "qualified immunity",
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 12345678,
      "caseName": "Smith v. City of Springfield",
      "court": "United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit",
      "dateFiled": "2026-03-15",
      "docketNumber": "24-1234",
      "snippet": "The district court denied qualified immunity..."
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/courts/opinion/:id

Get the full text of a court opinion by ID.

Parameters:
- id (path, required) — opinion ID from search results

```

```

### GET /v1/courts/dockets?q=

Search federal court dockets.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — docket search term
- court (query, optional) — court identifier

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/courts/dockets?q=Google"
```

What the data means: CourtListener indexes federal court opinions, oral arguments, and RECAP docket data. Court identifiers use CourtListener conventions (e.g. "scotus" for Supreme Court, "ca1" through "ca11" for circuit courts). Opinion IDs are stable and can be used to retrieve full text.

## Domain: Federal Register

Federal rules, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents from the Federal Register.

Source: Federal Register (GPO/NARA)
Source URL: https://www.federalregister.gov

### GET /v1/federal-register?q=

Search the Federal Register by keyword.

Parameters:
- q (query, required) — search term (e.g. "artificial intelligence", "emissions")
- agency (query, optional) — agency slug (e.g. "environmental-protection-agency")
- type (query, optional) — document type: "RULE", "PRORULE", "NOTICE", "PRESDOCU"
- dateAfter (query, optional) — publication date filter (YYYY-MM-DD)

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/federal-register?q=artificial+intelligence"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "federal-register",
  "source": "Federal Register",
  "source_url": "https://www.federalregister.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "artificial intelligence",
  "results": [
    {
      "documentNumber": "2026-05432",
      "title": "Request for Comment on AI in Federal Procurement",
      "type": "Proposed Rule",
      "agency": "General Services Administration",
      "publicationDate": "2026-03-28",
      "abstractText": "The GSA seeks public comment on proposed requirements...",
      "htmlUrl": "https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/03/28/2026-05432/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/federal-register/:docNumber

Get the full text and metadata for a specific Federal Register document.

Parameters:
- docNumber (path, required) — document number from search results (e.g. "2026-05432")

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/federal-register/2026-05432
```

What the data means: the Federal Register is the daily journal of the US Government. Rules are final regulations with the force of law. Proposed rules (PRORULE) are open for public comment. Notices include agency announcements, meeting schedules, and other administrative actions. Presidential documents include executive orders and proclamations.

## Domain: Education

College Scorecard data from the US Department of Education — admissions, costs, and earnings.

Source: College Scorecard (US Dept of Education)
Source URL: https://collegescorecard.ed.gov

### GET /v1/education?q=

Search schools by name.

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/education?q=MIT"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "education",
  "source": "College Scorecard (US Dept of Education)",
  "source_url": "https://collegescorecard.ed.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "MIT",
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 166683,
      "name": "Massachusetts Institute of Technology",
      "city": "Cambridge",

      "medianEarnings10yr": 124800,

    }
  ]
```

Parameters:
- id (path, required) — school ID from search results (e.g. "166683")

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/education/166683
```

What the data means: admissionRate is a decimal (0.04 = 4% acceptance rate). annualCost is the total cost of attendance for one academic year in USD. medianEarnings10yr is the median earnings of graduates 10 years after entry, in USD. studentSize is total enrollment.

## Domain: Infrastructure

Energy prices and broadband availability from EIA and FCC.

Source: EIA (Energy Information Administration) + FCC Broadband Map
Source URL: https://www.eia.gov + https://broadbandmap.fcc.gov

### GET /v1/infrastructure/electricity?state=

State-level electricity prices.

Parameters:
- state (query, optional) — two-letter state code. Omit for national averages.

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/infrastructure/electricity?state=CA"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "infrastructure",
  "source": "EIA",
  "source_url": "https://www.eia.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "state": "CA",
  "prices": [
    {
      "period": "2026-02",
      "price": 28.5,
      "unit": "cents/kWh",
      "sector": "residential"
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/infrastructure/gas?state=

State-level natural gas prices.

Parameters:
- state (query, optional) — two-letter state code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/infrastructure/gas?state=TX"
```

### GET /v1/infrastructure/energy-outlook

National short-term energy outlook from EIA. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/infrastructure/energy-outlook
```

### GET /v1/infrastructure/broadband?zip=

Broadband availability by ZIP code or state from the FCC broadband map.

Parameters:
- zip (query, optional) — 5-digit US ZIP code
- state (query, optional) — two-letter state code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/infrastructure/broadband?zip=48201"
```

What the data means: electricity prices are in cents per kilowatt-hour for residential customers. Gas prices are per thousand cubic feet. The energy outlook provides national forecasts for production, consumption, and prices. Broadband data reflects FCC provider availability reports.

## Domain: Unclaimed Property (Reclaim)

State-level unclaimed property search — finds unclaimed money, securities, and other assets held by state treasuries.

Source: State Treasury / Comptroller databases (50 states)
Source URL: https://unclaimed.org

### GET /v1/reclaim/search?name=&state=

Parameters:
- name (query, required) — full or partial name to search
- state (query, required) — two-letter state code (e.g. "CA", "NY", "TX")

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/reclaim/search?name=Smith&state=CA"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "reclaim",
  "source": "State of California - Controller's Office",
  "source_url": "https://ucpi.sco.ca.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "name": "Smith",
  "state": "CA",
  "results": [
    {
      "owner": "SMITH, JOHN A",
      "propertyType": "Checking Account",
      "amount": "$142.50",
      "holder": "WELLS FARGO BANK",
      "claimUrl": "https://ucpi.sco.ca.gov/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

### GET /v1/reclaim/sources

Returns metadata about supported states and their data sources. No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/reclaim/sources
```

What the data means: unclaimed property is money or assets held by financial institutions, employers, or government agencies that have lost contact with the owner. States hold these assets until claimed. Property types include bank accounts, insurance proceeds, stocks, wages, and utility deposits.

## Domain: Safety (Cross-Domain)

Composite safety profile for a US ZIP code combining water quality and hospital ratings.

Source: EPA SDWIS + CMS Care Compare
Source URL: https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/safety

### GET /v1/safety?zip=

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/safety?zip=48201"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "safety",
  "source": "EPA SDWIS + CMS Care Compare",
  "source_url": "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/safety",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip": "48201",
  "safetyScore": 65,
  "water": {
    "systemCount": 3,
    "healthViolations": 2,
    "worstContaminants": ["LEAD", "COPPER"],
    "score": 30
  },
  "hospitals": {
    "count": 8,
    "averageRating": 3.5,
    "best": { "name": "HENRY FORD HOSPITAL", "rating": 5 },
    "worst": { "name": "EXAMPLE MEDICAL CENTER", "rating": 2 },
    "score": 35
  }
}
```

What the data means: safetyScore is 0-100 (100 = best). Water component is 50 points max: starts at 50, loses 10 points per health-based violation. Hospital component is 50 points max: the average CMS star rating mapped to a 0-50 scale. This is a composite indicator, not a comprehensive safety assessment.


---


## Domain: Risk (Cross-Domain)

Multi-factor risk profile for a US ZIP code combining water, hospitals, weather, and demographics into a 0-100 risk score.

Source: EPA + CMS + NOAA + Census
Source URL: https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/risk

### GET /v1/risk?zip=

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/risk?zip=48201"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "risk",
  "source": "EPA + CMS + NOAA + Census",
  "source_url": "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/risk",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip": "48201",
  "riskScore": 62,
  "factors": {
    "water": { "score": 15, "max": 25, "violations": 2 },
    "hospitals": { "score": 10, "max": 25, "averageRating": 3.5 },
    "weather": { "score": 12, "max": 25, "severeOutlook": false },
    "demographics": { "score": 25, "max": 25, "povertyRate": 35.1 }
  }
}
```

What the data means: riskScore is 0-100 (0 = lowest risk, 100 = highest risk). Each factor contributes up to 25 points. Water risk increases with health-based violations. Hospital risk increases as average rating decreases. Weather risk increases with severe forecasts. Demographics risk increases with poverty rate.


---


## Cross-Domain Intelligence Endpoints

These endpoints combine data from multiple federal sources into unified responses. They represent the core value of OPP — structured intelligence that spans agency boundaries.


### POST /v1/ask

Natural language query routed to the right federal data domain. Send a question in plain English; the API identifies which domain to query, fetches the data, and returns a structured answer.

Parameters (JSON body):
- q (string, required) — natural language question

```
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q": "Is the tap water safe in Detroit?"}' \
  https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/ask
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "water",
  "source": "EPA SDWIS",
  "source_url": "https://enviro.epa.gov",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "query": "Is the tap water safe in Detroit?",
  "routed_to": "water",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

The router matches keywords in your question to the 30 data domains. It handles queries like "What are the side effects of metformin?", "Any food recalls this week?", "How safe is ZIP 90210?", "What's the unemployment rate?", "Any earthquakes today?", and "Find clinical trials for diabetes."


### GET /v1/alerts

Active federal alerts across food recalls and consumer product recalls. Surfaces Class I food recalls from FDA and active product hazards from CPSC.

No parameters required.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/alerts
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "alerts",
  "source": "FDA + CPSC",
  "source_url": "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/alerts",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "alerts": [
    {
      "domain": "food",
      "severity": "Class I",
      "product": "Organic Peanut Butter",
      "reason": "Salmonella contamination",
      "date": "20260301"
    },
    {
      "domain": "products",
      "severity": "high",
      "product": "Portable Space Heater",
      "hazards": ["Fire", "Burn"],
      "recallDate": "2026-02-15"
    }
  ]
}
```


### GET /v1/location?zip=

Full location profile combining demographics, safety score, water systems, and nearby hospitals for a single ZIP code.

Parameters:
- zip (query, required) — 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/location?zip=48201"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "location",
  "source": "Census + EPA + CMS",
  "source_url": "https://api.openprimitive.com",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip": "48201",
  "summary": "ZIP 48201, population 670,000, median income $31,283, safety score 65/100",
  "demographics": {
    "population": 670000,
    "medianIncome": 31283,
    "povertyRate": 35.1,
    "collegeRate": 14.2
  },
  "safety": {
    "safetyScore": 65,
    "water": { "healthViolations": 2, "worstContaminants": ["LEAD"] },
    "hospitals": { "averageRating": 3.5 }
  }
}
```


### GET /v1/compare?zip1=&zip2=

Side-by-side comparison of two US ZIP codes across demographics, safety, and quality of life metrics.

Parameters:
- zip1 (query, required) — first 5-digit US ZIP code
- zip2 (query, required) — second 5-digit US ZIP code

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/compare?zip1=48201&zip2=90210"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "compare",
  "source": "Census + EPA + CMS",
  "source_url": "https://api.openprimitive.com",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "zip1": "48201",
  "zip2": "90210",
  "comparison": {
    "population": { "48201": 670000, "90210": 21741 },
    "medianIncome": { "48201": 31283, "90210": 153146, "winner": "90210" },
    "safetyScore": { "48201": 65, "90210": 88, "winner": "90210" }
  },
  "summary": "90210 has higher income ($153,146 vs $31,283) and a better safety score (88 vs 65)."
}
```


### GET /v1/discover

Discovery endpoint that returns all available domains, their endpoints, and capabilities. Useful for agents exploring what data is available.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/discover
```


### GET /v1/federated

Federated query across multiple OPP-compliant servers. Queries the local server and any registered federation peers.

Parameters:
- domain (query, required) — data domain to query
- Additional parameters passed through to the domain handler

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/federated?domain=water&zip=48201"
```


---


## Infrastructure Services

These modules provide cross-cutting capabilities that enhance every data domain response. They are the operational backbone of the protocol.


### Entity Graph

Cross-domain entity resolution that stitches data across all 30 domains by common identifiers: ZIP code, company (CIK/ticker), drug name, geographic coordinates, FIPS code.

#### GET /v1/entity/:type/:identifier

Parameters:
- type (path, required) — entity type: "zip", "company", "drug", "geo", "fips"
- identifier (path, required) — the entity value (e.g. "48201", "AAPL", "metformin", "40.7128,-74.0060")
- domains (query, optional) — comma-separated list of domains to query (omit for all applicable)

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/entity/zip/48201
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "entity-graph",
  "entityType": "zip",
  "identifier": "48201",
  "freshness": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
  "results": {
    "water": { "systems": 3, "healthViolations": 2 },
    "air": { "aqi": 42, "category": "Good" },
    "demographics": { "population": 670000, "medianIncome": 31283 },
    "hospitals": { "count": 8, "averageRating": 3.5 },
    "weather": { "shortForecast": "Partly Cloudy", "temperature": 58 }
  }
}
```

What the data means: the entity graph resolves a single identifier across every domain that understands it. A ZIP code queries water, air, weather, demographics, hospitals, earthquakes, location, and eligible. A company identifier queries SEC, drugs, food, products, and spending. A drug name queries drugs, drug-interactions, clinical-trials, dailymed, and health. Domains are queried in parallel with a 10-second timeout per source.


### Subscriptions

Real-time event subscriptions with webhook delivery and Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming. Agents register interest in specific domains and receive push notifications when data changes.

#### POST /v1/subscriptions

Create a new subscription. JSON body:
- agentId (string, required) — unique agent identifier
- domain (string, required) — data domain to watch (e.g. "food", "drugs", "earthquakes")
- filters (object, optional) — domain-specific filter criteria
- webhookUrl (string, optional) — URL to receive POST notifications
- sse (boolean, optional) — enable Server-Sent Events streaming

```
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agentId": "my-agent-001", "domain": "food", "filters": {"classification": "Class I"}, "webhookUrl": "https://my-agent.example.com/webhook"}' \
  https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/subscriptions
```

#### GET /v1/subscriptions/:agentId

List all active subscriptions for an agent.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/subscriptions/my-agent-001
```

#### GET /v1/subscriptions/:agentId/stream

SSE stream for real-time events. Connect with an EventSource client.

```
curl -N https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/subscriptions/my-agent-001/stream
```

What the data means: subscriptions are stored in Redis with TTL-based expiration. Supported domain filters include drug name, product type, ZIP code, earthquake magnitude threshold, filing type, and more. Webhook payloads carry the full OPP envelope. SSE streams deliver events as they occur.


### Compliance Metadata

Regulatory compliance assessment against major AI governance frameworks. Tags API usage with jurisdiction-specific compliance scores so model providers can prove which data informed their outputs.

#### GET /v1/compliance/assess

Parameters:
- jurisdiction (query, required) — regulatory framework: "eu-ai-act", "nist-ai-rmf", "eo-14110", "canada-aida"
- domain (query, optional) — specific data domain to assess

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/compliance/assess?jurisdiction=eu-ai-act"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "compliance",
  "jurisdiction": "eu-ai-act",
  "framework": "EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689)",
  "effectiveDate": "2026-08-02",
  "assessment": {
    "provenanceChain": { "required": true, "satisfied": true },
    "signedResponses": { "required": true, "satisfied": true },
    "freshnessThreshold": { "required": 90, "actual": 0, "satisfied": true },
    "auditTrail": { "required": true, "satisfied": true },
    "transparencyReport": { "required": true, "satisfied": true }
  },
  "overallScore": 1.0,
  "compliant": true
}
```

Supported frameworks:
- **EU AI Act** (Regulation 2024/1689) — provenance chains, signed responses, freshness thresholds, audit trails, transparency reporting
- **NIST AI RMF** — risk management framework alignment with provenance and audit requirements
- **EO 14110** — Executive Order on AI safety and security, federal data provenance requirements
- **Canada AIDA** — Artificial Intelligence and Data Act compliance assessment


### Provenance Chains

SHA-256 content hashing for every upstream data fetch. Creates a cryptographic chain from the original government source through to the API response.

Every response can carry a provenance chain that includes:
- **contentHash** — SHA-256 hash of the raw upstream response body (`sha256:<hex>`)
- **sourceHeaders** — relevant HTTP headers from the upstream source (date, etag, last-modified)
- **fetchTimestamp** — ISO 8601 timestamp of when the upstream fetch occurred
- **tlsCertHash** — TLS certificate hash when available (Cloudflare Workers cf object)

```json
{
  "provenance": {
    "contentHash": "sha256:a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
    "sourceHeaders": {
      "date": "Sat, 12 Apr 2026 14:00:00 GMT",
      "etag": "\"abc123\"",
      "lastModified": "Fri, 11 Apr 2026 08:00:00 GMT"
    },
    "fetchTimestamp": "2026-04-12T14:00:01.234Z"
  }
}
```

What the data means: the content hash lets any consumer verify that the data has not been modified since it was fetched from the government source. Combined with the Ed25519 signature on the response envelope, this creates a two-layer integrity proof: the hash proves the upstream data is unchanged, and the signature proves the API response is unchanged.


### Temporal Archive

Versioned record storage with diff detection. Every data point keeps a complete history of changes over time, stored in Redis sorted sets with 2-year TTL.

#### GET /v1/history

Parameters:
- domain (query, required) — data domain (e.g. "water", "drugs")
- key (query, required) — record identifier (e.g. a PWSID, drug name, or ZIP code)
- from (query, optional) — start timestamp (ISO 8601)
- to (query, optional) — end timestamp (ISO 8601)

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/history?domain=water&key=MI0000101"
```

Response:
```json
{
  "domain": "archive",
  "key": "water:MI0000101",
  "versions": [
    {
      "timestamp": "2026-04-12T14:00:00.000Z",
      "hash": "sha256:abc123...",
      "diff": {
        "violations.total": { "from": 0, "to": 1 },
        "violations.healthBased": { "added": ["LEAD MCL violation"] }
      }
    },
    {
      "timestamp": "2026-04-11T14:00:00.000Z",
      "hash": "sha256:def456...",
      "diff": null
    }
  ]
}
```

What the data means: the temporal archive detects silent data edits — when a government source changes a value without announcement. Each version stores the full data snapshot hash. Diffs show exactly what changed between consecutive versions. This is critical for accountability and detecting retroactive data modifications.


### Confidence Scoring

Multi-dimensional confidence scoring with cross-source corroboration. Every response's confidence field is computed from four weighted dimensions.

Dimensions:
- **Source reliability** (40%) — baseline trust score per federal agency (e.g. SEC = 0.97, NOAA = 0.96, EPA = 0.93)
- **Data freshness** (30%) — decays over time: 1 day = 1.0, 7 days = 0.95, 30 days = 0.85, 90 days = 0.70, 365 days = 0.50
- **Completeness** (20%) — percentage of expected fields that contain non-null values
- **Corroboration** (10%) — agreement score when multiple sources report the same data point

When multiple sources cover the same field (e.g., FDA and DailyMed both report drug warnings), the confidence module detects agreements and conflicts. Agreements boost the corroboration score. Conflicts flag the discrepancy for downstream consumers.

```json
{
  "confidence": 0.93,
  "confidenceDetail": {
    "sourceReliability": 0.95,
    "freshness": 0.95,
    "completeness": 0.88,
    "corroboration": 0.90,
    "dimensions": {
      "sourceReliability": { "weight": 0.4, "score": 0.95 },
      "freshness": { "weight": 0.3, "score": 0.95 },
      "completeness": { "weight": 0.2, "score": 0.88 },
      "corroboration": { "weight": 0.1, "score": 0.90 }
    }
  }
}
```


### Federation Registry

Decentralized registry for OPP-compliant data providers. Any organization can register as a provider and be discovered by agents querying the federation.

#### POST /v1/registry/register

Register a new OPP-compliant provider. JSON body:
- name (string, required) — provider name
- url (string, required) — base URL of the OPP server
- domains (array, required) — list of data domains served
- publicKey (string, required) — Ed25519 public key for response verification
- contact (string, required) — contact email

```
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "State of California", "url": "https://data.ca.gov/opp", "domains": ["water", "air"], "publicKey": "...", "contact": "data@ca.gov"}' \
  https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/registry/register
```

#### GET /v1/registry

List all registered OPP providers.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/registry
```

#### GET /v1/registry/search?domain=

Search for providers serving a specific domain.

Parameters:
- domain (query, required) — data domain to find providers for

```
curl "https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/registry/search?domain=water"
```

What the data means: the federation registry enables a decentralized network of OPP servers. When an agent queries the federated endpoint, Open Primitive can fan out the request to all registered providers serving that domain, then merge and deduplicate the results. Each provider's responses are verified against their registered public key.

Returns the API index — all domains with endpoint paths, sources, and descriptions.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1
```

### GET /v1/stats

Public endpoint (no auth required). Returns real-time traffic analytics: agent vs. human breakdown, top agents, top endpoints, hourly traffic.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/stats
```

### GET /ping

Health check. Returns { "status": "ok", "timestamp": "..." }

### GET /v1/context

Returns contextual metadata about the API including version, supported domains, infrastructure capabilities, and protocol version.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/context
```

### GET /v1/changes

Returns a changelog of recent API changes, new domains, and infrastructure updates.

```
curl https://api.openprimitive.com/v1/changes
```

## MCP Server

Open Primitive runs as a Model Context Protocol server for direct tool use by LLMs.

### Via stdio (local)

```bash
node mcp.js
```

The MCP server exposes 34 tools:

| Tool Name | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| get-flights | Airline delays and weather. Optional param: airline (IATA code) |
| get-car-safety | NHTSA ratings and recalls. Params: year, make, model (all required) |
| get-food-recalls | FDA food recalls. Optional param: query |
| get-water-safety | EPA water data. Optional params: zip or pwsid |
| get-drug-safety | FDA adverse events. Param: name (required) |
| get-hospital-quality | CMS hospital data. Optional params: query or providerId |
| get-health-evidence | PubMed research. Param: query (required) |
| get-nutrition | USDA nutrition. Optional params: query or fdcId |
| get-jobs | BLS employment data. Optional param: seriesId |
| get-demographics | Census data by ZIP. Param: zip (required) |
| get-product-recalls | CPSC recalls. Optional param: query |
| get-sec-filings | SEC EDGAR. Optional params: query or cik |
| get-safety-profile | Cross-domain safety. Param: zip (required) |
| get-weather | NOAA forecast. Params: lat, lng (required) |
| get-location-profile | Location profile. Param: zip (required) |
| get-comparison | ZIP comparison. Params: zip1, zip2 (required) |
| ask-question | Natural language query router. Param: q (required) |
| get-risk | Multi-factor risk profile. Param: zip (required) |
| get-eligible | Benefits eligibility screening. Params: income, householdSize (required) |
| get-air-quality | EPA AirNow AQI by ZIP. Param: zip (required) |
| get-alerts | Active federal alerts. No params. |
| federated-query | Query across federation peers. Param: domain (required) |
| get-meat-safety | USDA FSIS meat recalls. Optional param: query |
| search-unclaimed-property | State unclaimed property search. Params: name, state (required) |
| search-court-records | Federal court opinions. Param: query (required) |
| search-federal-register | Federal Register documents. Param: query (required) |
| get-federal-register-document | Full Federal Register document. Param: docNumber (required) |
| search-schools | College Scorecard search. Param: query (required) |
| get-school | School detail by ID. Param: id (required) |
| get-electricity-price | EIA electricity prices. Optional param: state |
| get-broadband | FCC broadband availability. Optional params: zip, state |
| query-entity-graph | Cross-domain entity query. Params: type, identifier (required) |
| create-subscription | Create data change subscription. Params: agentId, domain (required) |
| assess-compliance | Regulatory compliance assessment. Param: jurisdiction (required) |

Each tool returns JSON wrapped in MCP text content format.

## A2A Agent Card

The A2A (Agent-to-Agent) discovery card is at:

```
https://api.openprimitive.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
```

The card follows the A2A protocol spec and lists all skills corresponding to the data domains and cross-domain endpoints. Agents can discover Open Primitive's capabilities by fetching this URL.


---


## OPP Protocol Summary

The Open Primitive Protocol defines three requirements for any compliant data server:

1. **Manifest** — Publish `/.well-known/opp.json` declaring your domains, endpoints, and signing key.
2. **Envelope** — Every response carries domain, source, freshness, confidence, citations, and a cryptographic proof field.
3. **Signing** — Response bodies are signed with Ed25519. Consumers verify the signature against the public key in the manifest.

OPP is open. Any organization serving structured data can publish a manifest and start signing responses. The spec is at https://openprimitive.com/protocol.html.


---


## Error Handling

All errors return JSON with an "error" field:

- 400: Bad request (missing required params) — `{ "error": "year, make, and model are required" }`
- 500: Upstream failure — `{ "error": "Internal server error" }`

Domain-specific errors (returned as 400):
- Cars: "year, make, and model are required"
- Water: "Invalid ZIP code" or "Invalid PWSID"
- Drugs: "Drug name required" or "No adverse event reports found for this drug"
- Hospitals: "Search query required" or "Provider ID required"
- Health: "Search query required"
- Nutrition: "query is required" or "fdcId is required"
- Food: "query is required" (search only)
- Demographics: throws on invalid ZIP
- Weather: "lat and lng are required"
- Ask: "q is required"
- Compare: "zip1 and zip2 are required"
- Location: "Valid 5-digit ZIP code required"
- Air: "zip parameter is required"
- Clinical Trials: "query parameter is required"
- Spending: "query parameter is required"
- Eligible: "income and householdSize are required"
- Courts: "query parameter is required"
- Federal Register: "query parameter is required"
- Education: "query parameter is required"
- Drug Interactions: "drug1 and drug2 are required"
- Reclaim: "name and state are required"
- Compliance: "jurisdiction parameter is required"
- Entity Graph: "Invalid entity type"


---


## CORS

All endpoints return `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: X-API-Key, Content-Type`. Browser requests work without a proxy.
